author: Legoche
body:
This is a tournament map made by Legoche, ImRaging and Bootey.

We started with a Wahiz/Rendezvous feel, but added a lot of our own touches. There is gold armour instead of iron, a few iron blocks in the middle, only water in the middle and the ability to obtain flint. The jungle leaves are useful for attackers and serve a similar purpose as to like the rafters without being as overpowered. The defense area is plain and simple. Spawn has multiple supply chests for defenders to use. The woolroom supplies include axes, logs, arrows, bows, chestplates and golden apples.

http://imgur.com/a/FYbil

Please leave your opinions in the comments, constructive criticism is advised!
:)

EDIT: Loadout - http://imgur.com/0ogPkKP
